name: solfiredancer
description: Antithesis property definitions for Firedancer Solana validator consensus testing

safety_properties.name: root_slot_never_decreases
safety_properties.description: The root (finalized) slot must be monotonically non-decreasing on every validator. A decrease indicates a finality violation.

safety_properties.name: no_equivocation
safety_properties.description: A validator must never vote on two different blocks at the same slot height. This is a slashable offense in Solana consensus.
safety_properties.message_pattern: equivocation: voted on two different blocks

safety_properties.name: vote_lockout_respected
safety_properties.description: Validators must not switch forks before their vote lockout expires. Lockout = 2^confirmation_count slots.
safety_properties.message_pattern: fork switch before vote lockout expired

safety_properties.name: ghost_weight_nonnegative
safety_properties.description: GHOST fork choice weights must never be negative. Negative weight indicates a stake accounting bug.

safety_properties.name: slot_timing_bounded
safety_properties.description: Slot boundaries must not drift more than 100ms from expected wallclock time. Excessive drift breaks consensus timing.

safety_properties.name: replay_meets_deadline
safety_properties.description: Block replay must complete before the validator's next leader slot deadline. Missing the deadline means skipped leader slots.
safety_properties.message_pattern: replay did not complete before leader deadline

safety_properties.name: bank_hash_agreement
safety_properties.description: All validators that finalize the same slot must agree on the bank hash. Disagreement indicates state divergence.
safety_properties.message_pattern: bank hash mismatch for finalized slot

safety_properties.name: no_shred_equivocation
safety_properties.description: A leader must not produce conflicting shreds for the same (slot, index). This is detectable by the eqvoc protocol.

safety_properties.name: no_duplicate_transaction_in_block
safety_properties.description: The pack tile must not include the same transaction twice in a single block.

liveness_properties.name: leader_produces_blocks
liveness_properties.description: At least one Firedancer validator should successfully produce a block as leader during the test.
liveness_properties.message_pattern: this validator produced a block as leader

liveness_properties.name: repair_recovers_shreds
liveness_properties.description: The repair protocol should successfully recover missing shreds at least once during the test.

liveness_properties.name: gossip_discovers_peers
liveness_properties.description: Gossip should discover all validators in the cluster at least once.

liveness_properties.name: gossip_reaches_saturation
liveness_properties.description: Gossip peer table should reach saturation (stable for 15 seconds).

liveness_properties.name: epoch_boundary_crossed
liveness_properties.description: The cluster should cross at least one epoch boundary during the test.

reachability_properties.name: fork_created_and_resolved
reachability_properties.description: A fork should be created and subsequently resolved during testing.
reachability_properties.message_pattern: fork was created and later resolved

reachability_properties.name: leader_rotation_occurred
reachability_properties.description: Leader rotation should occur (different validators produce blocks).

reachability_properties.name: repair_protocol_activated
reachability_properties.description: The repair protocol should be activated to fill at least one shred gap.

reachability_properties.name: snapshot_catchup
reachability_properties.description: A validator should catch up to the cluster via snapshot at least once.

reachability_properties.name: consensus_vote_cast
reachability_properties.description: A Firedancer validator should cast at least one consensus vote.

packet_drop.description: Drop incoming or outgoing UDP packets to simulate packet loss

packet_delay.description: Delay packet processing by 10-200ms to simulate network latency

partition.description: Partition a subset of validators from the rest of the cluster
partition.notes: Use Antithesis network fault injection to isolate containers

skew.description: Skew wallclock reads by +/- 100ms to stress timing-dependent code

write_failure.description: Fail blockstore or account DB writes to test crash recovery

read_delay.description: Delay blockstore reads to simulate slow storage

message_drop.description: Drop gossip messages to simulate partial cluster partition

response_failure.description: Fail repair responses to test shred recovery under adversity
